statement: A Japan national AI infrastructure will deploy 27,500 NVIDIA Rubin GPUs and 13,750 Vera CPUs across 140 MW of data-center capacity on Vera Rubin NVL72 racks.
why: A confirmed 27,500-GPU Rubin deployment evidences strong forward demand and that Rubin is reaching the field.

impact.mechanism: Large national-scale Rubin commitment adds firm forward merchant-GPU demand plus datacenter and power buildout.

evidence.excerpt: 13,750 NVIDIA Vera CPUs and 27,500 NVIDIA Rubin GPUs, 140 megawatts of data-center capacity

confidence.basis: Vendor press release via secondary newswire; no independent corroboration.
